items.title: Medtronic (MDT) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Analysts Lift Targets
items.summary: Price target expectations around Medtronic have shifted into a roughly US$92 to US$120 range, as analysts reassess what they think the stock is worth. Many of the more bullish voices link these higher targets to growth drivers in cardiovascular devices, cardiac ablation and soft tissue robotics, while more cautious research flags valuation questions and sector level risks. items.title: Medtronic (MDT) Won FDA Clearance For Hugo In 3.5 Million US Surgeries
items.summary: Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) received FDA clearance for its Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system for general surgery procedures in the U.S. The authorization expands Hugo's approved use beyond urologic surgery to a broader range of abdominal and soft-tissue operations. General surgery represents roughly 3.5 million procedures each year in the U.S., sharply widening Hugo's potential procedure pool. FDA clearance for Hugo in general surgery only tells part of the story of Medtronic's robotics push...
